Description

﻿We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated AI Utilization Specialist with robust data science acumen to support the Headquarters United States Air Force Strategic Deterrence and Nuclear Integration, Nuclear Systems Integration Division (AF/A10XC). The ideal candidate will drive the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and workflow automation within divisional processes while aligning operational practices with Department of War (DoW) guidance and policies. This position requires critical thinking, technical expertise, and collaboration across various stakeholders. Work will be performed onsite in the Arlington, VA area (Pentagon).

Duties and Responsibilities:
• Analyze divisional workflows to identify areas for process improvement through automation, recommending and implementing AI-driven efficiencies.
• Develop and implement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for AI tool deployment and utilization tailored to the needs of the AF/A10XC division.
• Interpret and apply DoW guidance, including GenAI.mil policies, ensuring AI employment adheres to regulatory, ethical, and technical standards.
• Act as a liaison between technical teams, leadership, and end-users to facilitate seamless adoption of AI tools and automated workflows.
• Create detailed documentation and training materials to support sustainable AI usage. Conduct training sessions as needed for end-users.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Active Top Secret (TS) clearance

Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Familiarity with AI tools, workflow automation and DoW AI policies (GenAI.mil)

Education:

Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) and a minimum of 10 years of professional experience, OR Master’s degree (MA/MS) with a minimum of 8 years of professional experience.

Desired Experience and Skills:

Familiarity with Air Force organizational structure, processes, and operations, particularly in the context of nuclear integration or strategic deterrence.

Working knowledge of collaboration platforms (e.g., SharePoint) and task management tools used in DoD or large-scale organizational settings.

Proven track record in developing workflow modernization frameworks and AI-based process enhancements.

DoD staff or Headquarters support experience

Location: Washington, D.C.

Required Qualifications

• Experience performing statistical, analytical, and data management techniques for intelligence and operational data.

• Ability to conduct extensive classified and unclassified research and reference searches, develop database retrieval strategies, and perform on-line reference search services.

• Skilled in evaluating the quality and relevance of large, diverse datasets, including formal research, data cleansing and synthesis, and database management.

• Proven experience in preparing and delivering technical analytical reports, presentations, memoranda, and supporting documentation using data-driven insights.

• Demonstrated proficiency in querying, organizing, extracting, and analyzing both structured and unstructured data using database tools.

• Experience supporting all aspects of the Data Science Life Cycle, including data collection, preparation, analysis, and generating actionable intelligence.

• Ability to provide technical advice, collaborate in developing data models, and generate performance measures to address critical management needs and compliance

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting intelligence community (IC) or federal agency analytics requirements.

• Advanced programming skills for statistical analysis and data modeling (such as Python, R, or SQL).

• Prior work developing or validating analytical and decision support tools for risk management or operational planning.

Education

• Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution in data science, computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, or a closely related field.

Location

• Washington, D.C. metro area. On-site support required at government facilities during the core business hours of 8:00 am to 4:00 pm Eastern time

Clearance

• Preferred clearance is Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI).

Georgetown University comprises two unique campuses in the nation’s capital. With the Hilltop Campus located in the heart of the historic Georgetown neighborhood, and the Capitol Campus, just minutes from the U.S. Capitol and U.S. Supreme Court, Georgetown University offers rigorous academic programs, a global perspective, and unparalleled opportunities to engage with Washington, D.C. Our community is a close-knit group of remarkable individuals driven by intellectual inquiry, a commitment to social justice, and a shared dedication to making a difference in the world.

Requirements

Job Overview

The Center for Security and Emerging Technology (CSET), under the School of Foreign Service, is hiring a Data Scientist. This role is on CSET’s Data Team, working collaboratively with software engineers, data analysts, and research fellows to maintain CSET’s data infrastructure, make data analytically useful through extraction, classification, clustering, annotation, and entity resolution, and produce rigorous policy research and high-quality data resources. This position will contribute to a new project focused on improving bibliometric data, developing methods and metrics to identify emerging areas in science and technology, and providing open data and infrastructure to support research and decision making, including improving CSET’s Map of Science and related tools.

About CSET & the Emerging Technology Observatory:

CSET is a research organization focused on studying the security impacts of emerging technologies, supporting academic work in security and technology studies, and delivering nonpartisan analysis to technologists and policymakers. CSET currently focuses on artificial intelligence, advanced computing and biotechnology. CSET is located in Georgetown University’s Capitol Campus near Union Station. Members of our team are challenged with meaningful work, offered ongoing opportunities for professional development and learning, and contribute to a collegial and engaging environment where they can thrive. We are deeply committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and encourage individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply.

CSET's Emerging Technology Observatory is a free public platform for data and insight on critical emerging technology issues. Building on CSET's unique data and analytic capabilities, ETO provides analytic tools and datasets to help users across government, academia, nonprofits and the private sector understand and act on global emerging technology trends.

The Data Scientist will report to CSET’s Director of Data Science and Research and have responsibility for:

Building and maintaining data pipelines and data processing techniques for large datasets using Airflow;

•
Designing, evaluating, and implementing solutions, including AI-enabled solutions and advanced modeling, to improve the quality and utility of datasets and enable new analytic capabilities;

•
Ingesting structured and unstructured datasets into Google Cloud Platform (GCP);

•
Documenting and communicating CSET methods and data resources to internal and external audiences;

•

•
Monitoring trends and developments in AI, ML, biotechnology, and national security policy

Upholding CSET’s mission, values and culture

Additional duties as assigned

This role sits at the intersection of research and product, ideal for someone eager to solve hard problems at scale using applied ML.

You'll lead the development of real-time ranking, recommendation, and personalization models, working closely with engineering and product stakeholders to drive measurable user impact.

Why This Role Stands Out:
• Core impact: Shape how users experience discovery and decision-making across the platform.
• End-to-end ownership: From model design to production deployment and performance optimization.
• Innovation-driven: Work with modern ML approaches-embeddings, ranking systems, and real-time inference.

• Build machine learning models for search relevance, ranking, and personalized recommendations.
• Develop and scale retrieval systems to support fast, relevant product discovery.
• Design full ML pipelines from data ingestion and feature engineering to model training and deployment.
• Experiment with embedding techniques, ranking algorithms, and personalization methods.
• Collaborate with engineering and product teams to embed models into core user-facing experiences.

What You Bring:
• 5+ years of hands-on experience in applied machine learning.
• Deep knowledge of recommendation systems, search, personalization, or ranking models.
• Strong Python skills and familiarity with ML libraries (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).
• Experience with distributed data processing (e.g., PySpark, ETL pipelines).

• Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical field.
• Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure.
• Familiarity with real-time inference systems or large-scale retrieval architectures.
• Ability to bridge ML research and product needs-delivering practical solutions with business impact.
